parts.text: "You are an OpenCode worker doing the FINAL pass on the SWA ERP project. Keep it factual and based on the repo. NEVER delete files, NEVER run rm, NEVER touch App.tsx/Sidebar/pages. 3) git add PROJECT_COMPLETE.md docker-compose.prod.yml deploy && git commit -m 'docs: PROJECT_COMPLETE handover + validated deploy config'. Write work/reports/wave-13/13-F-final.report.md."

display.text:
services:
  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-swa}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:?Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env.prod}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-swa_erp}
    volumes:
      - pg_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-swa} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-swa_erp}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10
    restart: unless-stopped

  backend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.backend
    env_file:
      - .env.prod
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://${POSTGRES_USER:-swa}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-swa_erp}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped

  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile.frontend
    depends_on:
      - backend
    restart: unless-stopped

  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT:-80}:80"
    volumes:
      - ./deploy/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:ro
    depends_on:
      - frontend
      - backend
    restart: unless-stopped

volumes:
  pg_data:
